author: Kushal
problem: Read six non-negative integers A, B, C, D, E, F (each up to 10^18) and print the remainder of A*B*C - D*E*F when divided by 998244353.
bug_description: The final difference is not reduced modulo 998244353, so it prints a negative number when D*E*F mod p is larger than A*B*C mod p.

comments.accurate: Prints the difference of the two products reduced modulo 998244353
comments.wrong_behavior: Prints the difference of the two products, each reduced modulo 998244353
comments.wrong_location: Final subtraction verified; check the order of the chained % mod reductions
